frontend/src/components/CountrySlideshow: Auto-playing slideshow of European countries with navigation controls and link to contact page.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimerSectio: Renders a disclaimer section with multiple styled blocks explaining limitations, accuracy, and legal notices for consultancy services.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with company info, navigation links, social links, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/GDPRSection.tsx: Shows a GDPR compliance overview with principles, explanations, and privacy-related details in a styled layout.
frontend/src/components/GlobeSection.tsx: Empty placeholder component with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a responsive header with navigation links, scroll-based styling, and a mobile menu drawer.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Presents the landing hero section with headline, CTA buttons, and feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/InteractiveGlobe: Empty placeholder component with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/MapSection.tsx: Renders an interactive world map image with an overlay button linking to contact page.
Renders a tabbed product offerings section with deep-linking, accordions, and smooth scrolling for different visa categories.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Displays key value propositions, service promises, and ancillary services in a styled marketing section.

frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Returns an empty query set since the site uses no backend data.
frontend/src/ic-assets.json: Configures asset rules to include the .well-known directory.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a purple-themed design system with gradients, variables, and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query and identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the landing page with hero, map, slideshow, and category sections.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the app’s routing structure with a shared layout and individual page routes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash params, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear stored or hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, domain-setup requirements for ICP, and tracks existing and pending features for custom domain integration.
